node.statement: Because S_{P_j,P_l} contains the nonzero product from child 1.2.3.1, its dimension is at least 1. Since P_j and P_l are one-dimensional t-projections and e=2t<=e_dim, lem-extcb-one-dimensional-corner-dimension gives dim S_{P_j,P_l}<=1. Therefore dim S_{P_j,P_l}=1, which is j~l.
